original_content_full: HPI students Lisa Ihde, Daniel-Amadeus Johannes Glöckner, Leonard Geier, Lukas Wagner and Tobias Markus won the German Multimedia Award MB21 in the age group 21-25 for their software SnailSnap, which uses KI to transform selfies into informative snail mosaics (more).
